content:
Last month, OpenAI teased hardware bearing the Codex brand. Today, the company officially launched its collaboration with Work Louder — the Codex Micro keyboard, priced at US$230.

Here's a product intro:

The keyboard comes in two versions: a clicky (blue switch, audible) edition and a silent edition.

According to the website: "Each Agent Key lights up with RGB effects based on Codex's real-time status, so before you switch conversations, you can see at a glance whether it's thinking, running, waiting, or already done."

The product page also lists three Codex-exclusive features:

  • Instant skill triggering: flip the joystick to kick off common Codex workflows — like reviewing PRs (Pull Requests), debugging errors, or refactoring code.
  • Core operations at your fingertips: command keys provide dedicated shortcuts for the most-used actions, including accept, reject, push-to-talk, new chat, and more. Less switching, faster shipping.
  • Freely adjustable compute: twist the dial to adjust the reasoning level on the fly. Keep it fast for simple tasks, crank it up when deeper thinking is needed.
